scope: Prospective engine latency/phase and worker-conformance workload. Not browser/app-startup or human authoring time, blind quality, independent research evaluation or a speed claim. Three small exploratory fixtures informed selection; this is not held-out evaluation. Frozen before this formal baseline, before any worker implementation. v1 failed its preflight intent: one case included an invalid empty optional claims array; v2 omits that property and preserves all data/statistics/outcome gates. Prior protocol, inputs, executor and all45 attempted outcomes remain.
